outcomes: Derived exact orbit/stabilizer cylinder and overlap-energy formulas for uniform group-orbit forced-support models.
Proved lambda h(S)<=alpha+beta|S| implies (j+1)b_{j+1}<=(alpha+beta j)b_j and mu(q)<=q alpha/(1-q beta), deriving the prior pressure hypothesis from a conditional-overlap property.
Instantiated the theorem on a dense planted Hamiltonian-cycle orbit with h(S)<=3, mu(q)<=3 lambda q, and chi2(P||Q)<=exp(3 lambda)-1.
Proved Poisson-relative factorial log-concavity j b_j^2>=(j+1)b_{j-1}b_{j+1} implies F(q)<=exp(qb_1) and mu(q)<=qb_1 for arbitrary signed/cancellative likelihood ratios.
Rewrote mu(q) as the normalized number-operator/Fourier-influence Rayleigh quotient of the noised likelihood ratio; Mao necessarily has liminf mu_n(q)/(D_n+1)>=1 in its strong-distinction regime.

Strongly Rayleigh/stable-polynomial negative dependence is Borcea-Branden-Liggett prior art.
Spectral-sample, total-influence, and noise-stability identities are classical.
No bounded search hit for the exact likelihood-ratio inference translations is not a novelty certificate.
